title: Environmental Regulation, Labor Income Share, and Implications for Inequality
title_zh: 环境规制、劳动收入份额及其对不平等的影响

abstract: Abstract Italy's slow human capital accumulation during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries is a key determinant of the limited inventive activity of the country. Whilst the education–innovation nexus was explored in previous research, the relationship between the diffusion of vocational and technical education (VTE) and inventive activity has not been assessed. In this paper, we present a brand‐new dataset of VTE schools across Italy's provinces in the period 1861–1911 and perform a two‐stage analysis. First, we investigate factors associated with the establishment of VTE schools. Second, we study the correlation between VTE and innovation using new patent data. The diffusion of VTE schools was linked to socio‐economic factors, highlighting the role of demand. In turn, the presence of VTE schools correlates with an increasing number of patents. We show that the VTE–innovation nexus was influenced by existing human capital levels, particularly the relative diffusion of mass education versus secondary schooling.
abstract_zh: 摘要 意大利在19世纪和20世纪期间人力资本积累缓慢，是该国发明活动受限的关键决定因素。尽管以往研究探讨了教育与创新之间的联系，但职业教育与技术教育（VTE）的普及与发明活动之间的关系尚未得到评估。本文提供了1861年至1911年间意大利各省VTE学校全新数据集，并进行了两阶段分析。首先，我们考察了与VTE学校设立相关的因素。其次，我们利用新的专利数据研究VTE与创新之间的相关性。VTE学校的普及与社会经济因素相关联，凸显了需求的作用。反过来，VTE学校的存在与专利数量的增加相关。我们表明，VTE与创新之间的联系受到现有人力资本水平的影响，尤其是大众教育与中等教育相对普及程度的影响。
title: Catching the technological frontier? Vocational and technical education (VTE) and inventive activity in Italy, 1861–1911
title_zh: 追赶技术前沿？意大利职业与技术教育（VTE）与发明活动（1861–1911）

abstract: Abstract Crop insurance is undoubtedly an extremely valuable element in protecting agricultural businesses, but in many cases standard indemnity‐based products have had very low uptake due to high transaction costs elevating premiums to unaffordable levels. Index insurance options in which coverage is written on a publicly observable “trigger” (involving much lower transaction costs) have begun to fill the void. In almost all of the previous economics literature on index insurance, the only variable that the insurance demander is permitted to choose is the payment to be received should the index trigger value be verified. However, it is clear that the trigger value itself is an integral element in the contract, and it is an element about which the insurance demander has clear preferences. In this article, we analyze the optimal demand for index insurance under the assumption that the demander can choose both the payment to be received if the index trigger is satisfied and the trigger value itself. We find that there is always an interior solution to this problem. We also consider the market equilibria that emerge under a variety of settings in regard to the position of the insurer. The article is cast within the scope of insurance for frost damage to a crop, but all of the results are directly applicable to any peril for which a publicly observable signal exists. The article shows that allowing the demander to choose both indemnity and trigger value should increase uptake of index insurance products.
abstract_zh: 摘要 农作物保险无疑是保护农业经营中极具价值的要素，但在许多情况下，基于标准赔偿的保险产品因高交易成本导致保费升至难以负担的水平，其参保率一直很低。以公开可观察的“触发值”为基础（涉及较低交易成本）的指数保险选项已开始填补这一空白。在以往几乎所有关于指数保险的经济学文献中，保险需求方唯一被允许选择的变量是当指数触发值得到验证时应获得的赔付金额。然而，显然触发值本身是合同的一个组成部分，且保险需求方对此具有明确的偏好。本文在假设需求方既能选择指数触发条件满足时应获得的赔付金额，又能选择触发值本身的情况下，分析了指数保险的最优需求。我们发现该问题始终存在内部解。我们还考虑了在保险公司所处位置的各种设定下出现的市场均衡。本文以农作物霜冻损害保险为背景展开，但所有结果直接适用于任何存在公开可观察信号的灾害类型。研究表明，允许需求方同时选择赔付金额和触发值应能提高指数保险产品的参保率。
title: How cold is too cold? A theoretical analysis of the optimal trigger for index insurance for frost damage to crops
title_zh: 多冷才算太冷？作物霜冻损害指数保险最优触发条件的理论分析
